verdict.rationale: Remote is a global EOR and payroll platform, so proactive compliance alerts are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows generic webhooks that push data-change events, such as company verification completing, and per-country required-field schemas. These are developer building blocks and adjacent features, not documented proactive alerts about compliance obligations triggered by new hires, new locations, or law changes.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get proactive alerts when a new hire, location, or law change creates a compliance obligation
